annotations.title: BMI calculator: body mass index and WHO category

description: Body mass index from weight and height in metric (kg, cm) or imperial (lb, in) units, its WHO adult category (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obesity class I-III) and the weight range that counts as normal for that height. For adults; a screening number, not a diagnosis. Use for health, fitness and nutrition apps. Example: weight=70, height=175. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

height.description: Height in cm (or inches with units=imperial)

weight.description: Weight in kg (or lb with units=imperial)
